1-s113.answer: Shakespeare — 1564, England; Chaplin — 1889, England; Tolstoy — 1828, Russia; Pushkin — 1799, Russia; Napoleon — 1769, France

2-s114.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 2, с. 114. Расскажи о первых английских поселениях в Новой Англии, используя данные выражения.
steps: The people in New England built wooden houses. They hunted in the woods and looked for nuts. They lived in peace and friendship with the Native Americans.
2-s114.answer: wooden houses; hunted, looked for nuts; peace and friendship

3-s114.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 3, с. 114. Прочитай описания и угадай слова.
steps: nut — орех; turkey — индейка; harvest — урожай; library — библиотека; interesting — интересный.

4-s114.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 4, с. 114. Дай ответы Кейт на вопросы Дональда.
steps: I've been great. The trip was wonderful. I got to America by plane. I was in New York. Yes, now I know that American Indians are Native Americans.
4-s114.answer: great; wonderful; by plane; New York; Native Americans

5-s114.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 5, с. 114. Разыграй диалог Дональда и Кейт.
steps: Donald: Hi, Kate, glad you're back. How are you? Kate: Everything is great. Donald: How was your trip to America? Kate: Wonderful. Donald: How did you get there? Kate: By plane. Donald: Where did you go? Kate: I was in Boston and saw the New England Aquarium. Donald: Have you learnt anything new? Kate: Yes, that American Indians are Native Americans.
5-s114.answer: How was your trip? — How did you get there? — Where did you go? — What have you learnt?

6-s114.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 6, с. 114. Придумай ещё 3–5 вопросов, которые Дональд мог бы задать Кейт.
steps: How long have you been in America? What did you like most? Did you make new friends there? What food did you try? Would you like to go there again?
6-s114.answer: How long…? What did you like most? Did you make friends? What food…? Would you go again?

7-s114.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 7, с. 114. По картинкам скажи, куда идут люди и зачем.
steps: They are going to the forest to hunt. He is going to the bank to put money in. He is going to the airport to go on holiday. They are going to the court to play tennis. She is going to the library to read a book. She is going to the supermarket to buy nuts.
7-s114.answer: to the forest to hunt; to the bank; to the airport; to the court to play tennis; to the library; to the supermarket

8-s115.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 8, с. 115. Прослушай новые слова и выражения.
steps: depend on — зависеть от: it depends on the weather; independence — независимость: Independence Day, 4 July; fight — fought — fought — сражаться: fight for independence; gold — золото; gun — ружьё; empty — пустой; situated — расположенный.
8-s115.answer: depend on, independence, fight/fought, gold, gun, empty, situated

9-s115.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 9, с. 115. Прочитай и переведи новые слова.
steps: colony — колония; plantation — плантация; rice — рис; tobacco — табак; attack — атака; police — полиция; president — президент.
9-s115.answer: colony, plantation, rice, tobacco, attack, police, president

10-s116.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 10, с. 116. Прочитай новые слова.
steps: depend /dɪˈpend/, independence /ˌɪndɪˈpendəns/, fight /faɪt/ — fought /fɔːt/, gold /ɡəʊld/, gun /ɡʌn/, empty /ˈempti/, situated /ˈsɪtʃueɪtɪd/.
10-s116.answer: depend, independence, fight/fought, gold, gun, empty, situated

11-s116.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 11, с. 116. Прочитай новые слова и выражения.
steps: Children depend on their parents. You can always depend on Jane. The American colonists wanted independence from England. Americans celebrate Independence Day on 4 July. They fought for their independence. People went west to look for gold. The house is situated near the river. The room is empty.
11-s116.answer: depend on, independence, fight for, gold, situated, empty

12-s116.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 12, с. 116. a) Вырази сомнение; b) не согласись с хвастуном Джоном.
steps: a) I don't think your parents depend on you. To be honest, you can't have a gold collection. Correct me if I'm wrong, but your brother has only toy guns. Speaking personally, I don't think it's true.
b) I'm not really sure you're right. I'm afraid I can't agree with you. You can't be serious! You must be joking!
12-s116.answer: a) I don't think… / To be honest… / Correct me if I'm wrong…; b) I can't agree / You must be joking!

13-s117.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 13, с. 117. Сыграй в игру с новыми словами.
steps: По очереди составляем предложения с depend, independence, fight, gold, gun, empty, situated — кто больше.

14-s117.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 14, с. 117. Составь предложения по заметкам (depend on).
steps: His life depends on his parents. My holidays depend on the weather. His work depends on the plan. Our meeting depends on the time.
14-s117.answer: depends on his parents / the weather / the plan / the time

15-s117.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 15, с. 117. Прослушай, прочитай и выучи стихотворение.
steps: Слушаем запись, читаем вслух и учим стихотворение наизусть.

16-s117.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 16, с. 117. Прочитай текст и ответь, почему американцы отправились на запад.
steps: The Americans went west to look for new lands and gold.
16-s117.answer: to look for new lands and gold

17-s118.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 17, с. 118. Ответь на вопросы по тексту.
steps: 1. The first colonies appeared in America at the beginning of the 17th century. 2. No, there were also Spanish and German colonies. 3. In 1733 there were thirteen colonies. 4. They didn't like depending on the English King. 5. In the 18th century they went west for new lands, in the 19th — for gold. 6. Life in the Wild West was full of danger.
17-s118.answer: 17th century; not only English; 13 colonies in 1733; independence from the King; west for lands and gold; full of danger

18-s119.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 18, с. 119. Составь с другом диалог о Диком Западе.
steps: A: What do you know about the Wild West? B: Only that life there was full of danger. A: The story began in the 18th century: Americans went west to look for new lands, then for gold. In the 19th century they built new towns there. B: Was it dangerous? A: Yes — there was no police, and people had guns.
18-s119.answer: went west for lands and gold; new towns; no police; full of danger

19-s119.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 19, с. 119. Составь план текста и кратко передай его суть.
steps: План: 1. The first colonies in America. 2. The fight for independence and the USA. 3. Going west. 4. Dangers of the Wild West.

Summary: The first colonies appeared in the 17th century. In 1733 there were 13 colonies. They didn't want to depend on England and fought for independence — that's how the USA appeared. Then Americans went west for new lands and gold. Life in the Wild West was full of danger.

20-s119.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 20, с. 119. Выполни упр. 12 (a) письменно.
steps: 1. It's very unlikely that your parents depend on you. 2. I doubt that you fight with them for your independence. 3. Are you sure you've got a lot of gold coins? 4. Your house isn't situated in Red Square, is it? 5. I have my doubts that your flat is always empty. 6. Your brother hasn't got a real gun, has he?
20-s119.answer: Сомнение: It's unlikely…, I doubt…, Are you sure…?

21-s119.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 21, с. 119. Вставь подходящие слова.
steps: 1. depends; 2. hard; 3. gold; 4. fight; 5. empty; 6. independence.
21-s119.answer: depends, hard, gold, fight, empty, independence

22-s119.condition: Lesson 47, упр. 22, с. 119. Образуй прилагательные от существительных (-ful).
steps: helpful, useful, beautiful, wonderful, colourful, peaceful.
22-s119.answer: helpful, useful, beautiful, wonderful, colourful, peaceful
